title: Visual Overhaul+
description: A mod pack dedicated to collecting the best work from the community to transform Java Edition
body:
# What This Modpack Is
This modpack aims to bring beauty into the game through revamped particle effects, biome dependant textures, shaders, and rendering techniques. It also adds some quality of life features such as better elytra mechanics and an upgraded hoe use. There are also some extra tools for builders to spruce up building.

# What This Modpack Is Not
This mod will not add any new major content into the game and nearly exclusively adds visuals to the game.
